chunks: Invocation when he faced the enemy
Our Lord! Decide between us and between our people with truth, and You are the Best of Deciders.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the Quranic verse 'Rabbana iftah' when recited during battle or facing enemies?
ai.summary: Imam Ali recites this verse during the Battle of Siffin, transforming a moment of military confrontation into a spiritual appeal for divine arbitration rather than mere physical victory. This reflects the Shia emphasis on *al-haqq* (truth/justice) as the ultimate criterion for success, aligning human struggle with God's will. The phrase 'best of those who open' (*khayr al-fatihin*) underscores the belief that true resolution comes from Allah, reinforcing the concept of *tawakkul* (trust in God) amidst conflict.
